decision_rationale: This is presented as a new multimodal conversational agent, not a review or wrapper. It explicitly combines DNA/RNA/protein inputs with English questions/answers and a language-model decoder that consumes projected DNA representations.
evidence_snippet: "ChatNT is a framework for genomics instruction tuning"; "curated dozens of English questions and answers"; "the question tokens are combined with the projected DNA representations before passing through the English language model decoder"; "DNA, RNA and protein tasks"
